instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Use 'Stethoscope', 'Activity', 'Calendar', 'Users', 'FileText', 'Printer' icons heavily.
Implement the Dashboard with a Bento Grid layout: Queue (Large), Stats (Small), Quick Actions (Medium).
Ensure ALL interactive elements have 'data-testid' for testing.
For Print Forms: Create a dedicated 'PrintLayout' component that is hidden from screen but visible to print media query.
Use the 'Merriweather' font ONLY for the header of the printed forms (Prescription, Medical Certificate).
Mobile Responsiveness: The Queue list must be easily scrollable on mobile. Buttons must be full-width on mobile.
AI Features: Add a 'Sparkles' icon button for 'AI Assist' in the SOAP notes section. Mock the API call with a toast 'AI generating suggestions...'
universal_guidelines: No gradients on text. Keep it clean and high-contrast.
Never center text in the dashboard widgets; align left for readability.
Use 'sonner' for all notifications (Success: 'Patient Added', Error: 'Failed to save').
Do not use generic blue for primary. Use the specified Teal (#0F766E).
